description: This file defines the public API for the Shared Multi-Heap (SMH) framework in Zephyr RTOS, including data structures, enums, and function prototypes for managing multiple memory regions with different attributes.

methods.name: shared_multi_heap_pool_init
methods.description: Initializes the shared multi-heap pool; must be called before adding regions.

methods.name: shared_multi_heap_alloc
methods.description: Allocates memory with specified attributes from the shared multi-heap pool.

methods.name: shared_multi_heap_aligned_alloc
methods.description: Allocates aligned memory with specified attributes from the shared multi-heap pool.

methods.name: shared_multi_heap_free
methods.description: Frees memory previously allocated from the shared multi-heap pool.

methods.name: shared_multi_heap_add
methods.description: Adds a memory region to the shared multi-heap pool.
